2121278560572768698.en_summary: $SPCX: SpaceX tries to catch both halves of Starship for the first time tonight. If successful, first full recovery of an orbital launch system. Flight 15 window 5:45 PM ET from Starbase Pad 2. Plan includes first catch attempt for V3 Super Heavy about 6.5 min after liftoff, ship deploys 26 Starlink V3 satellites, then first ever ship catch around 3:45 PM ET Saturday.
2121278560572768698.zh_summary: $SPCX：SpaceX今晚首次嘗試捕捉Starship的兩個部分。若成功，將是軌道發射系統的首次完全回收。第15次飛行窗口為美東時間下午5:45，從Starbase Pad 2發射。計劃包括起飛約6.5分鐘後首次捕捉V3 Super Heavy，飛船部署26顆為Starship建造的Starlink V3衛星，然後在週六美東時間下午3:45左右首次捕捉飛船。
